item.title: Suzy Yowell
item.description: CASA of Tarrant County has appointed of Suzy Yowell as Director of Community Partnerships. In her role, Yowell leads efforts to grow volunteer involvement, build strong local partnerships, and increase CASA’s presence and impact across the county.

item.title: Hunter Brous
item.description: Falcon Realty Advisors announced that Hunter Brous has joined the firm as Director of Landlord Services. With more than a decade of experience, he will lead the growth of Falcon’s landlord services platform and help owners drive long-term value.
